author: Dave Nay
name: Luxafor Flag

descriptions.en_US: Control a Luxafor Flag USB status light with direct USB HID communication -- no Luxafor SDK and no Luxafor cloud/web API involved. Assign a color (including Off) to a button; pressing it lights the Flag that color. Every Luxafor Flag button on your deck automatically shows whether its own color is the one currently active, so a bank of color buttons behaves like a set of radio buttons.

short-descriptions.en_US: Set your Luxafor Flag's color over direct USB HID
